items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S991

SPONSOR: HOYLMAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act directing the commissioner of the office of parks, recreation and
historic preservation to provide for the re-designation of Donald J.
Trump State Park, in Putnam and Westchester counties to a name other
than Donald J. Trump State Park

 
PURPOSE:

This bill would direct the commissioner of the office of parks, recre-
ation and historic preservation to rename Donald J. Trump State Park.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section I of the bill provides for the re-designation of Donald J.
Trump State Park as well as the installation and maintenance of signage
to this effect.

Section II sets forth the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

New York State has always been known for its history of welcoming and
embracing people of all cultures and backgrounds. Even our park system
reflects these values. According to the Declaration of Policy of the
Office of Parks Recreation and Historic Preservation, our parks should
foster and strengthen the sense of purpose, well-being and identity of
the citizens of this state. The names of these parks and green spaces
should embody the goals of uplifting and unifying New Yorkers. For these
reasons the Donald J. Trump State Park should be renamed.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

S.0443 of 2019-2020 (Hoylman): Died in Cultural Affairs, Tourism, Parks
and Recreation
A.5320 of 2019-2020 (Rozic): Died in Tourism, Parks, Arts and Sports
Development
S.7206 of 2018 (Hoylman): Died in Cultural Affairs
A.8669 of 2017-2018 (Rozic): Died in Tourism

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
Immediately.

BILL NUMBER: S991A

SPONSOR: HOYLMAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act directing the commissioner of the office of parks, recreation and
historic preservation to provide for the re-designation of Donald J.
Trump State Park, in Putnam and Westchester counties to a name other
than Donald J. Trump State Park

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 of the bill directs the Commissioner of the New York State
Office of Parks, Recreation & Historic Preservation to rename Donald J.
Trump State Park, subject to an appropriation for the installation and
maintenance of appropriate signage and other improvements of the park
for the enjoyment of the public.

Section 2 of the bill is the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

New York State has always been known for its history of welcoming and
embracing people of all cultures and backgrounds. Even our park system
reflects these values. According to the Declaration of Policy of the
Office of Parks Recreation and Historic Preservation, our parks should
foster and strengthen the sense of purpose, well-being and identity of
the citizens of this state. The names of these parks and green spaces
should embody the goals of uplifting. and unifying New Yorkers. For
these reasons the Donald J. Trump State Park should be renamed.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

S.0443 of 2019-2020 (Hoylman): Died in Cultural Affairs

A.5320 of 2019-2020 (Rozic): Died in Tourism

S.7206 of 2018 (Hoylman): Died in Cultural Affairs

A.8669 of 2017-2018 (Rozic): Died in Tourism

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

the enjoyment of the public.

more, by directing the Commissioner of the Office of Parks, Recreation &
